logic.indicator: Recursive EMA: alpha=2/(span+1), seed EMA[0]=the first completed UTC daily close, EMA[j]=alpha*close[j]+(1-alpha)*EMA[j-1], Python float adjust=False, initialized once from the first archived daily close and never reset at folds.
logic.entry: At the close of a fully completed UTC daily bar j, if EMA_fast[j] is strictly greater than EMA_slow[j] and the account is flat, set desired-long. Equality preserves previous desired state.
logic.exit: At the close of a fully completed UTC daily bar j, if EMA_fast[j] is strictly below EMA_slow[j] while long, set desired-cash. Equality preserves prior desired. No stop, target, confirmation counter, cooldown, overlap or scale-in.
logic.timing: The daily close is available at the next UTC 00:00; execute at the following UTC 00:01 one-minute open, exactly 60 seconds later. That historical open is only a historical-backtest reference. Warmup establishes indicators but produces no pre-OOS trade.
logic.account: One separate 2,000-USDT long-only spot account per asset/span configuration. The raw weight is 100% of that account to the named single asset when long. Full affordable LOT_SIZE-floored amount is bought, all units are sold at exit. No leverage, shorting, borrowing, transfer, yield, cross-asset rebalancing or shared impact.
logic.terminal: Liquidate any position at the declared common terminal UTC 00:01 reference with full modeled costs.

sources.citation: Technical trading rules in the cryptocurrency market (2019), daily simple moving-average rules on 11 cryptocurrencies, 2016–2018.
sources.scope: Motivates a daily trend-rule falsification test; not evidence for this EMA rule or modern OOS profitability.
